# SpeakPower

> Strategy, communication audits, public speaking coaching and narrative
> architecture for founders, NGO leaders and corporate teams in Uganda and East
> Africa — plus the websites, applications and internal systems the strategy
> runs on. Founded and run by Otieno Thomas, Kampala, Uganda.

SpeakPower diagnoses where communication breaks down, rebuilds it around a
single data-backed thesis, and then builds the system the strategy needs in
order to stay in daily use. The distinguishing claim is delivery: the strategy
and the software come from the same person, so positioning ships as working
infrastructure rather than as a document that decays.

## Services

- **Strategy & Market Development** — Go-to-market messaging built on market
  research, audience behaviour and competitive positioning rather than
  assumption. Delivered in person or virtually.
- **Communication Audits** — A line-by-line review of decks and documents with a
  structural diagnosis and a rebuilt draft, not just a list of notes. Virtual,
  results in one session.
- **Public Speaking Through Data** — Talk and pitch restructuring around the
  evidence a specific audience needs, with rehearsal under realistic pressure.
  Not generic tone and posture drills. In person or live virtual.
- **Team Workshops** — Turning fragmented team messaging into cohesive
  storytelling aligned to one brand narrative, with ongoing alignment check-ins.
- **Narrative Architecture for Startups & Nonprofits** — Rebuilding an
  organisation's story around a single defensible thesis ahead of a raise,
  launch or donor campaign. Virtual, project-based.
- **Digital Systems & Applications** — Designing and building the website, web
  application, internal tool or data dashboard a communication strategy runs on,
  written by the same person who produced the positioning. Project-based, design
  through deployment.

## Free tool

**Message Clarity Audit** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower-/audit.html

A free client-side diagnostic. Paste a pitch, positioning paragraph or proposal
and it returns a measured score across six dimensions: Flesch Reading Ease and
Flesch-Kincaid grade level, sentence length distribution and variance, passive
voice rate, hedging density, category jargon density, and evidence density
(figures cited per 100 words). The scoring rubric, component weights and source
citations are published on the page. Analysis runs entirely in the visitor's
browser; no text is uploaded or stored.

## The POLSSE framework

Every engagement runs through the same five lenses, because a message that only
works in one room is not ready yet.

1. **Politics** — Speaking with clarity and influence in public and policy
   spaces, where the message must survive being repeated by someone else to
   people you will never meet.
2. **Organizations** — Uniting teams around a single coherent message, so sales,
   support and the founder all tell the same story.
3. **Law** — Communicating ethically and compliantly; holding the line between
   persuasive and misleading on purpose rather than by accident.
4. **Security** — Protecting voice, data and reputation once a message leaves
   the room it was said in.
5. **Socioeconomics** — Turning speaking into social impact and economic
   opportunity: why the message matters beyond the room.

## Products built in-house

SpeakPower designs and ships its own software, which is the evidence behind the
claim that the strategy and the system come from the same person.

- **CuePointe** — see https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower-/work.html
- **Tonninyira** — see https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower-/work.html

Both are browser-only builds deployed on GitHub Pages; Tonninyira runs a
Supabase/Postgres backend behind a single-file front end.

## Who it is for

- Founders and startup teams refining positioning or preparing to raise.
- NGO and development-sector leaders working on donor narratives and programme
  communication.
- Corporate teams needing internal message alignment or entering a new market.

## How it differs from an agency

An agency sells output — a campaign, an identity, a deliverable set. SpeakPower
starts diagnostically: establishing what the data says about the audience and
the market before any copy is written. Where an agency scopes a build and
subcontracts it, here the same person produces the strategy and the software.

## Delivery formats

In person across Kampala and Uganda; live virtual for coaching, audits and team
workshops; and periodic live online masterclass cohorts on a single topic.
